import json,urllib.request,urllib.parse,os
tok=os.environ.get("GITHUB_TOKEN","")
print("token ada:",bool(tok))
u="https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q=uncensored+created:%3E2026-11-10&per_page=5"
h={"Accept":"application/vnd.github+json","User-Agent":"curl"}
if tok: h["Authorization"]=f"Bearer {tok}"

    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=40) as x:
        d=json.load(x); print("total:",d.get("total_count"))
        for it in d.get("items",[])[:5]: print(" ",it["full_name"],"|",(it.get("description") or "")[:80])
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: print("HTTP",e.code,e.read().decode()[:200])
